key_findings: Synovial and CSF 2-AG levels correlated positively with acute pain after total knee arthroplasty, more strongly in females.
MAGL and COX-2 are co-expressed in synovium and MAGL inhibition by MJN110 raised 2-AG and lowered PGE2 ex vivo.
